product_metadata.title: Bad Boy Bacon Maker for Microwave - Crispy Bacon Cooker For Microwave Oven - Breakfast Maker for Crispy, Healthy, and Low Fat Bacon Cooking - Pack of 2
features: In the Box: Includes 2 Microwave Bacon Cooker that cooks healthy and crispy bacon within minutes.

Cooks Up To 6 Slices: Add up to 6 slices per bacon maker, snap the strap, and microwave for crispy bacon in microwave! Conveniently-sized bacon cooker for microwave oven that fits even in the smallest microwave oven.

Healthy Cooking: Our bacon microwave cookware is designed to reduce fat. The fat drains away through the specially designed holes leaving healthier, crispier, and low fat bacon. Tip: When used for shorter durations, badboy bacon maker can be used as a bacon warmer.
Easy-to-Clean: Dishwasher safe for hassle-free cleaning, or use dish soap and warm water. The bacon does not stick to our silicone bacon cooker for microwave oven!
NOTE: Not intended for use with butcher-cut thick bacon, which does not cook well in a microwave oven. Bad Boy Bacon maker microwave bacon tray/food tray also available!
